assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness that are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard ambulatory monitoring.
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0).
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1).
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is indicated.
The service correlates symptoms with arrhythmic events and guides further management.
The service is medically necessary and consistent with the clinical indication.
The claim for CPT code 93247 was denied.
CPT code 93247 represents a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before the service was rendered.
Coverage cannot be applied to the claim because the procedural requirement was not met.
The member retains the right to appeal this determination.
